page.layout: One page of running text in one column; in the right margin, after the text, one reference mark set in the margin beside the line "dam ratione in bonum couertit" is not present, so no margin notes. Running head at top centre. Catchword-like line at the foot right: "fite-" is a line-end hyphenated word continuing onto the last line, not a catchword.

main_text.p: dam rationein bonum couertit.Gen.50. 20. Quàm multis & eximijs Dei feruis, qui nunc carcerum,exilij,paupertatis,ini quisimorū præiudiciorū & anathema-tismorum incommodis laborat, propter ueritatis amorem & profesionem, hæc tristia mala non multo pòst erunt utilia & honorifica coram Deo & electis angelis & hominibus?

5. An non autem magna est incogitantia & in iudicando hebetudo, non uidere, quòd improborum hominum, (quos Deus in lubrico posuit,Psal.73.18.)successus rectà eos ad horribile præcipitium deducant? Et quòd eorum opes & delitiæ ipsis sint pro reti,quo miserè intricati dét poenas?

6. Quò autem maiora certamina, Dei caussa Pijs adeunda & superanda sunt, tanto magis elucet fidei, quæ mundum vincit,decus: & tanto erit illustrior victoria. Fidus est hic fermo,ut ait Paulus Apostolus.Nam si cum Christo mortui sumus,cum eo etiam uiuemus:si toleramus,etiam cum eo regnabimus: Tim.2.11.12. Item : Qui uicerit,amicietur uestimentis albis: neq; delebo nomè eius ex libro uitæ,sed pro-fite-

page.notes: Printed text in the gutter/left edge is show-through and omitted. Doubtful: "Dei caussa" is set as printed in the scan ("Dei causa Pijs"); "successus" printed with long s; "profesionem" and "est" as printed; "tanto erit" in the scan reads "&tanto erit" and is transcribed with the ampersand as printed. Last word "profite-" continues on the following page. Verse references printed as "Tim.2.11.12." and "Psal.73.18." are transcribed as printed; "Gen.50. 20." is printed as "Gen.50*" in the running line.
